content: Standard append-only mmap store pattern is fixed-size, immutable, rolling segments (Kafka log segments; Rust crates commitlog and seglog both implement this) rather than one ever-growing mapping. Each segment file is opened at a fixed max size, mmapped once, never remapped; when full, a new segment is created and mmapped separately. Existing Bytes/slices referencing old segments stay valid forever. This directly avoids memmap2's remap-invalidates-slices hazard.
